_comment: Cited share-class weights for multi-class filers (#552 COWORK #31), in listed-class equivalents per share, keyed by StatementClassOfStockAxis member. Weight 1 only where the filer's own 10-K (or, for a new listing with no 10-K yet, its IPO prospectus, 424B4) states the classes are economically equal (1:1 convertible and equal dividend/liquidation rights); a stated conversion ratio otherwise. A filer not listed here, or a class not named in its entry, is refused. Read by lib/server/secCoverClasses.ts. An optional epsMember names the class to read EPS for when it is not the listed cover class (BRK's EPS is per equivalent Class B share); read by lib/server/secInstanceEps.ts.
